subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram owner-session delivery proof, or may maintainers accept source/CI proof only for this session-routing fix?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the changed behavior is a user-visible Telegram delivery path where mocks and CI do not prove the real transport/session result.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Wait for redacted Telegram Desktop, gateway log, terminal/live output, or linked-artifact proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, with maintainers explicitly owning the risk that live topic/session delivery still misroutes or drops completions.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Liveness Work
options.body: Pause this PR and move the useful owner-session completion tests into the broader Telegram detached-subagent liveness work if maintainers want one unified delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted Telegram Desktop, gateway log, terminal/live output, or linked-artifact proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent heartbeat/task-completion history and is the best available owner for deciding whether to accept source-only proof on a Telegram-visible delivery path.
